title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.

providers.name: PingOne
providers.scope_notes: Covers PingOne (PingOne Platform / Management APIs). SaaS; covers PingOne platform Worker apps and gateway credentials; inbound traffic policies need a Cloudflare-based custom domain.

controls.name: Application enable/disable toggle
controls.what: Disables a Worker app so it cannot be used.
controls.setting: Applications > Applications > (app) > toggle; API: PUT application enabled=false

controls.name: Role assignments (Roles tab / roleAssignments API)
controls.what: Worker app access equals its admin role assignments, scoped to org, environment, population, group, or application, and checked on each API call.

controls.name: assignActorRoles
controls.what: When false, an API-created Worker app does not inherit the creator's roles.

controls.name: Generate New Secret
controls.what: Replaces the client secret and keeps the previous one valid for a chosen window (1 minute to 90 days).
controls.setting: Applications > (app) > Configuration > Generate New Secret; application secret API

controls.name: Revoke Previous Client Secret
controls.what: Ends the grace period for the old secret immediately.
controls.setting: Applications > (app) > Configuration > Revoke Previous Client Secret

controls.name: Inbound traffic policies
controls.what: Allow or block requests by CIDR and other verify rules, only on Cloudflare-based custom domains.

controls.name: Delete application
controls.what: Removes the Worker app and its secret (logged as APPLICATION.DELETED).

no_control.what: Issued PingOne API (Management API) access tokens cannot be revoked; they stay valid until expiry (60 min default).

controls_unknown: Whether disabling the app or rotating the secret invalidates already-issued access tokens (role removal does take effect per call per S5)

authentication.summary: A Worker app authenticates to POST /{envID}/as/token with its client ID and secret (or client_secret_jwt / private_key_jwt) and gets a 60-minute JWT access token. The token has admin-level access to the PingOne Management APIs, limited by the app's own role assignments. No user signs in, so sign-on policies and MFA do not apply to it (docs describe it as a userless app; no explicit SSO-bypass statement).

federation.details: Docs describe client secret and private_key_jwt client authentication; no workload identity federation for Worker apps was found.

ip_restriction.boundary: Inbound traffic policies (IP allow/block via CIDR verify rules) exist only for Cloudflare-based custom domains. Docs do not say they cover api.pingone.com Management API calls or the default auth.pingone.com token endpoint.

lifetime.summary: Access token 60 min; client secret has no documented expiry

renewal.expiry_basis: Secret is long-lived until rotated; app requests a new token with the same secret
renewal.summary: No refresh token; reuse the client secret. On rotation the previous secret can stay valid 1 minute to 90 days.

administration.summary: Admins create Worker apps and assign admin roles scoped to org, environment, population, group, or application. Apps created via API inherit the creator's roles unless assignActorRoles=false. Apps can be disabled with the toggle; removing all roles blocks token issuance.
administration.conditions: An actor cannot grant roles it lacks; reading the secret requires a superset of the app's roles.

offboard.details: client_credentials tokens use the application's own role assignments, not a user's.

inventory.details: GET /v1/environments/{envID}/applications lists all applications, including Worker apps, per environment.

token_format.notes: Access token is an RS256 JWT; client secret is at least 64 characters for PingOne-generated secrets.

log_sources.name: PingOne Audit (Monitoring > Audit) and GET/POST /v1/environments/{envID}/activities
log_sources.notes: Configuration events kept 2 years, user events 90 days; queries max 14 days; Audit API rate 10/second.

log_sources.name: Subscriptions (webhooks)
log_sources.notes: Streams audit events to HTTPS/TCP endpoints; events lost if target down >7 days.

credential_id_fields.notes: Worker app (client) ID that performed the action
Application ID on APPLICATION.* / SECRET.* events

lifecycle_events.notes: Old secret still in use after rotation

anomaly_cues: New ROLE_ASSIGNMENT.CREATED on a Worker app, especially cross-environment
Config changes with actors.client.id of a Worker app from a new source.ipAddress

containment.steps: Generate a new secret and revoke the previous secret, remove role assignments, or disable/delete the app. Existing access tokens cannot be revoked; removing roles cuts access on the next call.
containment.notes: Role removal is checked per call (S5); token revocation is not available for PingOne API tokens (S8).
